text:
cassie (Design): Quick sweep — noticed the focus halo on toolbar buttons in dark theme is barely visible (2px, very low alpha). Also seeing keyboard nav weirdness where the overflow menu sometimes skips focus after open. Can we do a quick audit?
ryan (Frontend): Can you paste a screenshot and repro steps? I think that's the translucent outline: `rgba(255,255,255,0.08)` on `#0b1220`. Might need higher alpha or different approach.
cassie (Design): Screenshot attached in thread (see screenshot.jpg). Repro: Tab into top toolbar, hit Space to open overflow menu, then press Tab — focus jumps to content below instead of next menu item. Sequence: Tab x4 -> open menu -> Tab -> jump.
sam (A11y): Assigning a11y tag — two separate issues: contrast of the focus indicator, and focus management for the menu. Quick notes: 1) WCAG focus visibility — target a contrast goal (practical rule: visible halo with at least ~3:1 against adjacent BG). 2) Prefer `outline` or `outline-offset` to box-shadow for consistent rendering when transforms are used. 3) For the menu, ensure the menu DOM is not removed from tab order (or trap focus while open). Use `aria-expanded` + `aria-controls` and `role="menu"` / `menuitem` semantics if it's a true menu, or ensure roving tabindex pattern if custom. Also check screen reader announcements for duplicate labels.
marta (QA): I can repro on Win10 + Chrome. Also tested with NVDA and saw focus land weirdly. I recorded a quick screencap. VoiceOver on mac reads "Button, menu, button" when opening which seems like duplicate announcements.
ryan (Frontend): Quick CSS patch idea while we decide on color:
```
.toolbar button:focus {
  outline: 3px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}
.menu[aria-hidden='false'] {
  position: relative; /* ensure it's in DOM flow for focus */
}
```
If design prefers brand accent, we could use `#7DD3FC` as focus accent in dark mode. Need to verify with designers for contrast.
cassie (Design): I like the 3px outline for now. Can we also avoid purely color-only cue (add subtle inner glow/scale or icon?) Designers: thoughts on using accent vs neutral?
ryan (Frontend): Neutral is safer for now. Accent color could be used for active states but focus should be highly visible across themes. I'll prototype both and post screenshots. Also will audit the JS that toggles `aria-hidden` — looks like we remove menu from DOM for animation which breaks tabbing. We should keep it in DOM and hide visually or manage focus trap.
marta (QA): Add to QA checklist: keyboard navigation smoke, focus visibility in dark/light/high-contrast, and screen reader smoke for the menu pattern. I'll add a Cypress test to tab through toolbar and assert focus lands inside menu and loops correctly.
sam (A11y): A few further tips: - Use `prefers-contrast: more` media query to bump contrast for users who request it. - For assistive tech, ensure we set `aria-expanded` on the button and `aria-labelledby` for the menu container. - Avoid duplicating accessible names on open (maybe `aria-live` happening?).
cassie (Design): Decision for immediate PR: implement 3px outline for dark theme, keep menu in DOM while open + roving tabindex fix, and add Cypress e2e for tab order. Non-blocking: revisit accent color in next design pass.
ryan (Frontend): Will open PR with the CSS + JS fix + tests. PR ref: #1420 (WIP). I'll tag design for the color check and sam for a11y review.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: staging today 18:30 UTC
marta (QA): I'll run screen reader smoke once PR lands on staging. Marking severity: P1 for a11y clarity but not a production blocker.
sam (A11y): :thumbsup: Thanks all — small follow-ups: add release note blurb about this a11y improvement so CS/SE teams know, and add the accessibility checklist entry to the release template.
cassie (Design): I'll add the release note. Thanks everyone — keep the thread updated with PR link and screenshots.
